scenarios.title: Repair LDAP client defaults after a directory move
scenarios.summary: Separate a directory URI, a search base and a search scope while repairing a client lookup.
scenarios.objective: Repair the virtual client defaults to use ldap://directory.cedar.test and the People branch (ou=People,dc=cedar,dc=test). Write a search returning every person in that subtree, including Remote, with uid and cn only. Exclude Archive. Verify both the changed directory and the disclosed default-setting checks; a -b override alone does not repair BASE.
steps: Repair the virtual configuration, run actual simulated searches and check the independent cases.
scenarios.explanation: URI chooses directory.cedar.test and BASE chooses ou=People,dc=cedar,dc=test. A subtree person filter includes both direct People users and the nested Remote user. uid/cn selects the required output fields. A one-command -b can diagnose the correct branch, but the independent configured-default checks still fail until BASE is repaired. A missing base, zero matches and an unavailable supplied URI are different outcomes.
hints: Separate URI selection, BASE location, scope, entry filters and returned attributes before editing.
Use the sample directory and inspect a failed case. A missing base is different from no matching entries.
Use a People subtree person query; keep defaults correct.
scenarios.simplifications: Checked2026-11-09: LPIC-2v4.5/210.3 and upstream OpenLDAP2.6.10 manuals/RFC4511/4514/4515. Bounded read-only ASCII directory, parsed DNs, declared matching rules and base/one/sub scopes. Literal ldapsearch -x -LLL with -H/-b/-s and equality/presence/AND/OR/NOT filters; no substring/ordering/extensible filters, Unicode preparation, bind/SASL/TLS/protocol, LDAP updates/LDIF import, schema/ACL administration, aliases/referrals, host files/processes/network or personal credentials. Unknown supported-shape filter types evaluate Undefined. Source-held multiple rosters and default-setting probes; separate practice and drafts. Full210.3/210.4 remain incomplete.
solution:
LDAP CLIENT WORK
{"config":"URI ldap://directory.cedar.test\nBASE ou=People,dc=cedar,dc=test\n","command":"ldapsearch -x -LLL '(objectClass=person)' uid cn"}

scenarios.title: Build an on-call contact query that survives roster changes
scenarios.summary: Select entries by role and available contact data, then request only the needed attributes.
scenarios.objective: Using the supplied virtual directory ldap://directory.cedar.test, return only on-call People subtree persons who have a mail attribute. Select uid and mail only; include nested Remote people when they qualify. Keep URI and BASE defaults correct for the People branch. The same query must work when the supplied roster changes, including no matches.
steps: Repair the virtual configuration, run actual simulated searches and check the independent cases.
scenarios.explanation: Keep the virtual URI and BASE pointed at the People branch. Combine objectClass=person, description=on-call and mail=* with AND, then select uid/mail. Presence checks whether mail exists; it does not print its value by itself. The unchanged query must select the new qualifying users in Changed directory inputs and return no entries successfully for No matching on-call contacts. Do not hardcode a uid or include Archive by widening the base.
hints: Separate URI selection, BASE location, scope, entry filters and returned attributes before editing.
Use the sample directory and inspect a failed case. A missing base is different from no matching entries.
Combine person, description=on-call and mail=* with AND; select uid/mail and keep the People base.

solution:
LDAP CLIENT WORK
{"config":"URI ldap://directory.cedar.test\nBASE ou=People,dc=cedar,dc=test\n","command":"ldapsearch -x -LLL '(&(objectClass=person)(description=on-call)(mail=*))' uid mail"}

initial.instructions: Using the supplied virtual directory ldap://directory.cedar.test, return only on-call People subtree persons who have a mail attribute. Select uid and mail only; include nested Remote people when they qualify. Keep URI and BASE defaults correct for the People branch. The same query must work when the supplied roster changes, including no matches.
